title: Barber (full-time)
text: Your own chair, your own regulars and a team that cares about the craft. At least two years of barbering experience, and a licence.

title: Apprentice barber
text: Learn from Marco and Dev over two years, with paid study time. No experience needed, just patience and a steady hand.

title: Front of house (part-time)
text: Run the diary, greet walk-ins and make the shop feel like a club. Weekends and one weeknight.
